description: Weighted average remaining lease term in years as of a date (actual days ÷ 365.25), weighted by each lease's area_sf (weight_by "area") or annual_rent (weight_by "rent"). Deterministic: the same inputs always give the same result, with formula ID calc.walt@1, every step, and any warnings.

as_of.description: Date to measure remaining term from, YYYY-MM-DD.

leases.description: Leases in the portfolio or building.

annual_rent.description: Current annual rent, USD per year (required when weight_by is rent). Must be greater than 0.

area_sf.description: Leased square feet (required when weight_by is area). Must be greater than 0.

id.description: Your identifier for the lease (ideally a FactLot lease ID).

weight_by.description: How each lease is weighted: "area" uses its area_sf, "rent" its annual_rent (that field is then required on every lease). Default "area".

name: calc_walt
title: Weighted average lease term (WALT)
